findings.note: Landscape wraps the board in a ScrollView, but each card's DragGesture(minimumDistance:0) fights the ScrollView pan: either scrolling is defeated (board covers the viewport) or vertical run-drags scroll instead of drag and leave `drag` stuck at zIndex 10 (self-heal only fires on a completed move). Unverifiable this session (sim wedged). Fix: replace the landscape ScrollView with a no-scroll fit-to-height layout so drag/tap/coordinate behavior is identical to portrait.

boardStack pins .frame(width: cardW*8+gap*7), narrower than the old full content width by the floor remainder (0-<8pt), shifting the right-aligned foundations left in PORTRAIT — refuting the 'byte-identical' claim. Fix: portrait must use the exact old inline upperArea/tableauArea (full width); only landscape uses the width-pinned centered boardStack.

goldChecked >= seeds-2 tolerates 2 seeds silently losing their gold line; silverChecked>0 passes with a single silver survivor. Absent lines slip through green. Fix: assert every seed has a gold line (all 366 do), and assert the silver count equals the actual expected number (recompute from the pool via dailyChallenge: count days whose silver.id is certified).

The 'objective checkers' guard pins only acesFirst + downOpeners20; kingsFirst/jacksDownFirst/suitsTopDown/suitSprint bodies are unpinned, so a Swift divergence there wouldn't trip CI. Fix: pin the distinctive authoritative bodies of the remaining structural checkers too.
